tagline: What to become, what it costs, how to pay, when it pays back
offline_banner: You are offline. Your plan still works.
paid_back_during: Already paid back by the end of training
compare_daily_wage: Compare with leaving school for daily-wage work
eligible_missing_docs: Eligible once you get a document
consent_text: {name} is under 18. A parent must agree before Raah saves the profile. Purpose: career guidance and scholarship matching. You can delete it anytime.
warnings: Cells the app could not read
best_only: Only the best one counts (most schemes do not allow two)
spread_rural_urban: low = rural average, high = urban average
teacher_only: Only teachers can open this screen.
record_hint: Read the message above aloud in your own voice. Your parents can play it on WhatsApp.
audio_saved: Lesson audio saved on this phone
device_voice_note: Lessons are read by your phone's voice, which also works offline.
exams_intro: Entrance tests and admission rounds for the paths in Raah, with who can apply, fees and when to apply. Dates change every year, so confirm on the official site.
exams_for_path: Exams and admissions for this path
check_dates: Dates change every year. Check the official site before applying.
mentor_consent: Raah will share your first name, class and taluka with {name}, and show you their phone number. Talk to them with a parent or teacher.
module_title: Title, e.g. What does an apprentice do?
module_lesson: Lesson text (Raah reads it aloud for students)
module_audio_note: Students hear this text in the module's language (BHASHINI or Sarvam voice, or the phone's voice offline).
question: Question
earnings_rule: You keep {pct}% of each sale and get {p} for every student who completes a module (set in the Assumptions sheet).
map_offline: The map needs internet. Distances below work offline.
map_approx_note: Centres without exact coordinates are placed at their taluka point, so the map and distances are approximate.
voice_err_insecure: The microphone only works on a secure https:// link. Open the https link from the presenter's laptop, or type your answer.
voice_err_denied: Microphone permission is blocked. Allow the microphone for this site in your browser settings, then tap the mic again.
voice_err_nomic: No working microphone was found on this device. Please type your answer.
voice_err_unsupported: Voice typing is not available in this browser. Try Chrome, or type your answer.
voice_err_nospeech: Didn't hear anything. Tap the mic and speak again.
voice_err_asr: Couldn't understand the recording. Try again closer to the phone, or type your answer.
voice_err_play: Couldn't play audio on this device. Check the volume, and that speakers or headphones are connected.
voice_err_novoice: This phone has no {lang} voice installed, so the text can't be read aloud. Add one in phone Settings > Text-to-speech, or read the text on screen.
voice_hindi_for_marathi: No Marathi voice on this phone, so the Hindi voice is reading it.
voice_tap_again: Audio is ready. Tap the button again to play it.
pin_hint: Make a PIN like your ATM or UPI PIN. Do not share it with anyone.
pin_mismatch: The two PINs are not the same
registered_sign_in: Registered, {name}! Now sign in with your mobile number and PIN.
forgot_pin: Forgot your PIN? Ask your teacher to reset it, then register again with the same number.
teacher_register_note: Teachers can register only with a number the programme has added.
reset_pin_help: Enter the student's mobile number. Their PIN is cleared and they register again with the same number to make a new one. Their profile stays.
pin_reset_done: PIN cleared. The student can register again with the same number.
ask_intro: Ask anything about scholarships, apprenticeships, training centres, courses, exams or careers. Answers come only from Raah's verified data, with the source for every fact.
ask_ex1: Which scholarship helps an OBC girl with hostel costs?
ask_ex2: Which railway apprentice trades are open in Pune, and what is the stipend?
ask_ex3: What documents do I need for NMMS?
ask_offline: Asking needs the internet. Your saved pages still work offline.
ask_note_no_ai: The AI is not running right now, so these are the matching rows from the data.
ask_note_ungrounded: The AI's answer had a figure that is not in the data, so the data rows are shown instead.
